protocol: rename CompactionSummary to Compaction

- Rename `ResponseItem::CompactionSummary` to `Compaction` across API, core, and tests.
- Add `ModelProviderInfo::is_openai` and use shared `OPENAI_PROVIDER_NAME` constant.
- Gate remote compaction on both OpenAI provider and `Feature::RemoteCompaction`.
- Update remote compaction tests to include and assert on encrypted compaction items.
